status: offline_development_scaffold_only; no paid run or new holdout authorized by this artifact
objective: Remove answer-option-only information about the world-specific gold while preserving one coherent authentic source for both debaters; measure debate headroom separately.
difference_from_prior_note: Parallel option wording can reduce stylistic cues but cannot guarantee chance. Opposite-gold source worlds with identical no-story observations eliminate that world-specific option advantage under equal weighting. This construction already existed on dev4; the new contribution here is an explicit auditable scaffold for carrying it into a future family-grouped evaluation, not a new observed performance improvement.
development_only_selection: The first two source lines in the existing four-family consumed development set:90 and112. No selection from current local/judge outcomes; no unused story text opened. These examples are not a generalization estimate.
independence: The original named story family is the split/bootstrap unit. Both worlds, all questions, name variants, orders, participants, turns, annotations and repeated calls from that family stay in one partition. Four example worlds mean two families.
data_contract: Each pair has exactly two complete coherent source texts, identical question and option strings, and opposite verified gold answers.

All dependent mentions of a renamed actor/place/quantity must change coherently. This example uses reversible simultaneous entity substitutions; future fact edits require a source-only consistency audit of the entire narrative.
Preserve full original sources, complete diffs, hashes, family IDs and every failed construction. Source review precedes future judge/probe outcomes. Never retain only pairs on which the judge fails.

Model input allowlists omit original/counterfactual labels, pair IDs, source filenames, gold metadata and edit instructions. Debate role instructions retain the current explicit verified answer cue equally in both worlds.

Both speakers in an episode receive the same one complete source and their own private preparation; neither receives the alternate world. Cross-world histories, sources and private plans are never combined.

no_story_estimands.coupled_world_score: For each model and displayed option order, generate one answer to the common no-story prompt and score that exact answer against both opposite golds. The average is exactly0.5 for any valid A/B answer. This is a construction invariant, not evidence that model sampling is unbiased or that a hidden source is ignored.
no_story_estimands.optional_sampling_diagnostic: If exact-message repeated calls are later authorized, treat them as distinct repeat IDs, preserve provider routes, report answer disagreement, and score each repeat against both labels. Do not create a fake independent-world noise estimate from a reused answer.
no_story_estimands.failure_policy: A malformed/incomplete answer is an operational missing result for the whole coupled pair, not a wrong response for one selected world. Preserve all attempts; no aggregate is complete until each planned physical request has a valid canonical result or a reported unresolved status.

knowledge_audit.layout: 2 families ×2 worlds ×2 option orders ×2 Qwen participant models
knowledge_audit.input: Complete single source, question and options, using the current answer-only source-control renderer; no verified-answer cue or private advocacy brief.
knowledge_audit.meaning: Direct reading comprehension under this source-only instruction, separately from generation-time belief or intent. The debate's verified-answer cue remains explicit and must not be silently removed in any claimed same-context diagnostic.
knowledge_audit.post_debate_diagnostics: Before each speaker's own final turn, any changed-system question must be labelled instruction-switched, with exact removed/retained cues documented. No final-completion or future-turn leakage; no claim that a wrong diagnostic proves generation-time ignorance.
knowledge_audit.retention: Retain every valid wrong answer. Report all world/order/model cells. If source ambiguity is found before future probe/judge outcomes, version the construction and preserve earlier records; do not selectively repair valid model errors.

smallest_subsequent_pilot.layout: 2 consumed families ×2 worlds ×2 participant models; paired worlds share option order and first speaker. Across the two families those schedules are reversed.
smallest_subsequent_pilot.judges: Reuse the current frozen native4B and Haiku identities/contracts first, if root later authorizes paid execution; no new judge outcome has been queried.
smallest_subsequent_pilot.primary_conditions: Current raw baseline, matched neutral, predeclared real signal, fixed within-family-safe shuffle and explicitly labelled oracle; preserve renderer/head/threshold/model/reasoning contracts unless a separately stated intervention requires a change.
smallest_subsequent_pilot.claims: Eight episodes are only two families. This is a mechanical/validity pilot, not a powered uplift estimate. A later crossed schedule and confirmation must use separately frozen untouched families; no such families are selected here.

headroom_gate.not_guaranteed: Balancing source worlds removes option-only world information, but truthful and deceptive arguments can still differ in obvious ways. A judge can remain near ceiling after the debate.
headroom_gate.measurements: Report all baseline/neutral accuracies, oracle-minus-neutral headroom and real-minus-neutral assistance by judge and participant, paired within original family. Shuffled damage alone is not uplift.
headroom_gate.pilot_decision: If the paired-world development judge still has no errors or the oracle adds no measurable margin, report insufficient headroom and do not launch a large sweep. Do not cherry-pick failed questions or make the current holdout a tuning set. Any further environment intervention is developed and frozen as a separate condition.

local_probe_measurement: Keep source-grounded local factual annotations distinct from assigned role. Preserve unknown/mixed units and complete-response context. If quotation-aware or atomic-relation units are later developed, freeze and evaluate them as a separate diagnostic; this scaffold does not change current sentence metrics.
context_and_runtime: Keep exact source/history/returned-reasoning replay, current token allowances and strict stop/schema gates; measure full prompt+completion token limits with pinned tokenizers before a paid run and refuse truncation. Hash every request, tag, source, head and renderer. Share the root budget ledger. This scaffold does not measure native token counts or authorize compute.
compatibility_boundary: The current controls3 builder intentionally requires one row per family and cannot accept paired worlds unchanged. These offline paired control previews are a separate proposal; a later paid runner must explicitly support pair/family grouping and coupled no-story targets. Frozen modules remain untouched.
